titles_en.title: The Nine-Tailed Fox That Defiled Me

description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Anytoon](https://www.anytoon.co.kr/webtoon/episode/8264), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9464538), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000056396), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=230267), [Comico](https://www.comico.kr/comic/9266), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/miho_defiled_me)

Education, looks, fame, money. Hwang Bo-dam, a man who has everything. There was one thing he didn't have. He is a perfect, clean-cut wall man who doesn't even get dust even if he hangs it upside down and shakes it off.

One day, there was a tall woman who approached him not only with dirt but also with a bad smell. I'm starting to get attracted to her, who doesn't seem to care.

Hairy and dirty gumiho Hong who wants to become a human and end his life quickly VS Dam, a clean man who wants to live a long, chaste and innocent life!
